## Pull request overview

Implements several Feb 2026 ROADMAP P1/P2 deliverables across core/runtime, console i18n, documentation, and examples to improve DX/UX (error codes, debug tooling, localized console UI, and missing docs).

**Changes:**
- Added `@object-ui/core` error code registry + `ObjectUIError` hierarchy, plus debug utilities (`OBJECTUI_DEBUG`) with tests and exports.
- Integrated `@object-ui/i18n` into the console app and migrated several UI strings to `t('console.*')` keys across all locales.
- Added MIGRATION_GUIDE.md, a new Hello World example, and multiple missing package READMEs; updated ROADMAP checkboxes.

### Reviewed changes

The JSDoc claims debug logging is a "No-op in production", but `isDebugEnabled()` only checks the OBJECTUI_DEBUG flags and will still log in production if enabled. Either update the comment to match the actual behavior, or gate debug output behind `NODE_ENV !== 'production'` if production logging is not intended.

This example schema uses component types like "Page"/"Card"/"Text"/"Button", but the default registry registrations in `@object-ui/components` use lowercase types (e.g. `page`, `card`, `text`, `button`). As written, the Hello World example will hit the "Unknown component type" path. Update the schema to match the registered type strings.
```suggestion
  "type": "page",
  "title": "Hello ObjectUI",
  "children": [
    {
      "type": "card",
      "children": [
        { "type": "text", "content": "Welcome to ObjectUI!" },
        { "type": "text", "content": "This UI is rendered from a JSON schema." },
        { "type": "button", "content": "Get Started", "variant": "default" }
```

The Hello World example renders a schema but never imports `@object-ui/components` (or calls `initializeComponents()`), so the ComponentRegistry will likely be empty and component types won’t resolve. Add a side-effect import of `@object-ui/components` (or call the init helper) before rendering to ensure the built-in renderers are registered.

SchemaErrorBoundary gained new dev-mode UI (error code + suggestion), but the existing tests for SchemaErrorBoundary/SchemaRenderer don’t assert this behavior. Adding/adjusting tests to cover the error-code rendering (and the suggestion source) would help prevent regressions.

This README claims "11 built-in locales", but the package currently has 10 locale files (en, zh, ja, ko, de, fr, es, pt, ru, ar). Either add the missing 11th locale or update the documentation to match the actual supported locales.

SchemaErrorBoundary attempts to show a dev-mode suggestion via `objuiError.details?.suggestion`, but `createError()` stores suggestions in `ERROR_CODES`, not in `details`. As a result, most ObjectUIError instances will show an error code but no suggestion. Consider deriving the suggestion from `ERROR_CODES[objuiError.code]` (or using `formatErrorMessage`) and reserving `details` for error-specific context.

`debugTime()`/`debugTimeEnd()` currently wraps only React element creation and ends before React actually renders/commits the component, so the logged "render" timings will be misleading (near-zero and not representative). Consider using React Profiler (`<Profiler onRender={...}>`) or measuring commit timing inside components/effects, or rename the metric to reflect what it measures.
